label: About
title: About Sparse CFP Margin Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 547 recent saved-signal files and 78 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around swyx (@swyx) on X and CFP Advice, plus 7 more. A source image from swyx.io helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Sparse CFP Margin Field: Sparse CFP margin field, poster crop under overhead scan: one warm off-white card inside a hairline border, left red rule, huge empty upper-right. A hero-scale charcoal title-mass sits left-of-center; a second inset article-field holds the lower edge. After the image was made, the mask pass used geometry and contour candidates to attach source windows to the visible marks.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
